बॉलीवुड के दिग्गज डायरेक्टर महेश भट्ट ने फिल्म Ramayana में अपने दामाद रणबीर कपूर की परफॉर्मेंस पर बड़ा खुलासा किया है! 😲👏

Variety India से बातचीत में महेश भट्ट ने बताया कि जब फिल्म में श्रीराम के 14 साल के वनवास वाला सीन आया, तो वे अपने आंसू रोक नहीं पाए। उन्होंने कहा कि Ranbir Kapoor ने इस रोल के जरिए अपने अंदर छिपे भगवान को छू लिया है। ✨

महेश भट्ट ने डायरेक्टर Nitesh Tiwari की संवेदनशीलता और Ravana के किरदार में Yash की एक्टिंग की भी जमकर सराहना की। 🎬

इतना ही नहीं, Alia Bhatt ने भी Ramayana के सेट से बेटी Raha की तस्वीरें शेयर करके रणबीर की मेहनत और डेडिकेशन की तारीफ की। 4000 करोड़ रुपये के बड़े बजट में बन रही यह फिल्म दो पार्ट्स में दर्शकों के सामने आएगी! 💸

क्या आप भी Ranbir Kapoor को पर्दे पर श्रीराम के रूप में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Mahesh Bhatt says he was in tears watching son-in-law Ranbir Kapoor in Ramayana, feels actor ‘touched the God in him’
ctx.summary: Mahesh Bhatt praised Ranbir Kapoor’s portrayal of Lord Rama in Ramayana, recalling that the exile scene brought him to tears.
ctx.text:
Ramayana is receiving praise from all quarters, but for actor Ranbir Kapoor , some of the most special appreciation has come from his family. Ranbir's father-in-law and filmmaker Mahesh Bhatt lauded the film, particularly Ranbir's portrayal of Lord Rama. During a recent interaction, Mahesh recalled how he almost broke down while watching the scene in which Rama is sent into exile.
Speaking to Variety India, Mahesh said, "Just before the interval, Rama was sent into exile for 14 years. I felt my throat close. I tried hard not to cry. I had gone [to watch the film] with young filmmakers and writers, and people in the hall knew they were sitting with Ranbir Kapoor’s father-in-law. When the lights came on, I tried to hide my tears. I couldn’t. Nor could I say much. Great experiences make you silent."
Mahesh also praised the film's director, Nitesh Tiwari, for his sensitive portrayal of Rama and Ravana. He lauded Yash's performance as Ravana and said Ranbir's portrayal of Rama brought out a side of the actor that his previous films had not explored. He said, "Yash mesmerized me as Ravana. Nitesh Tiwari reins in all that power; it could so easily have become too much. I was still under its spell when Ranbir entered, and the film did not immediately rise for me with his arrival. Then he walked towards the camera and folded his hands. I saw him touch something in himself that his other films had never asked him to. I felt he had touched the God in him. As the family gathered around Rama, the epic came close. Arun Govil was heartbreakingly total."
On Thursday, Alia Bhatt had shared pictures of their daughter Raha from the sets of Ramayana and penned a heartfelt note for Ranbir. Praising his dedication to the film, she wrote, “You poured everything into this one and somehow still had all of it left for her. So proud of you Ranbir and of every single person who brought their heart and soul to this incredible experience at the movies. Some stories are bigger than all of us & Ramayana is one of them.”
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Indian epic. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman.
The ensemble cast also includes Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, and Kajal Aggarwal. Sunny Deol is set to play Lord Hanuman in Part 2. Produced by Namit Malhotra, the ambitious project has a combined budget of ₹ 4,000 crore for both instalments.
